context: Yumiko and Sakura chat about a busy week.
purpose: Casual home register; adverbs (こうした/そうした/一応/むしろ/さすが) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お母さん、今週は本当に忙しかった。
lines.en: Mom, this week was really busy.
lines.style: tired adult daughter voice, soft warm relaxed throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: こうした時こそ、休まなきゃね。
lines.en: It's at times like this you must rest.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一応、明日は休みにしたの。
lines.en: I made tomorrow a day off, just in case.
lines.style: relieved adult daughter voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: さすが、ちゃんと考えているわね。
lines.en: As expected, you're thinking it through.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm approving delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: むしろ、家でゆっくりしたいな。
lines.en: Rather, I'd like to relax at home.
lines.style: soft adult daughter voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうした日も、たまには必要よ。
lines.en: Days like that are needed now and then.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm affectionate delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: こうした会話も、落ち着くなあ。
lines.style: warm adult daughter voice, soft warm content delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうした時間を、大切にしましょうね。
lines.style: tender mother voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
